notes.title: #TBT to one of our favourite collabs: the Paradox Comic Book! 📖
notes.content:
It’s been six years since we published the Paradox Comic! 🎊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/4ee2c505d70d3620d030ccadd8ea65291e3f147a.jpg
The original Paradox Comic Book by Lau Kwong Shing (@cowcowtony) remains one of our most treasured pieces of Rusty Lake merch in our office. The stunning artwork, blended with Lau’s own interpretation of the lore in Cube Escape: Paradox, expertly brought to life by the incredible team at @zbfghk, still leaves us in awe.

Years before Paradox was released, we discovered Lau’s amazing Rusty Lake fan art through our #FanArtFridays, and we were instantly captivated. His unique style and vision stood out immediately, especially when he pitched the idea of a comic based on Rusty Lake: Roots. We loved the concept, but at the time, we were deep in production for the Cube Escape: Paradox film and game. Instead, we asked if he’d be interested in creating something for the launch of Cube Escape: Paradox, and without hesitation, he jumped right in. The result was a brilliant new layer to the Paradox story, seamlessly woven into the Rusty Lake universe.

We’re still so proud and honoured to have collaborated with Lau early in his career on such an extraordinary project. And now, six years later, we’re thrilled to partner with Lost in Cult to re-launch the Paradox Comic Book in a new edition to celebrate the 10th anniversary of Rusty Lake, so even more people can experience this masterpiece.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/614174a6219d3e72bff4647bbd124fe409769576.jpg

Don’t miss out on this beautiful anniversary edition and get yours today!

🔗 https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct

Happy 10 years of Rusty Lake! 🥳 And what better way to celebrate a decade of Rusty Lake than with:

Keep an eye out for secrets while playing The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, and you might just find an early look at our next Rusty Lake adventure! Wishlist now to stay up to date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/79fc9db394a84f82d17eecccf67771e750806427.png

 🎵 Rusty Lake: Sounds of the Lake 10th Anniversary Vinyl Collection - 20 of Rusty Lake’s Greatest Hits performed by Victor Butzelaar.

Whether you’ve been a part of our Rusty Lake universe since the first launch of a Cube Escape title back in 2015, or you’ve joined our journey during our later years, we’d like to share a heartfelt Thank you! from the whole Rusty Lake team! 

Thanks to you and your incredible support, we’ve had an amazing 10 years, and we’re as excited as ever to continue exploring the mysteries of Rusty Lake with more video games, short films, tablet-top experiences and much more! We hope you’ll stick around for what’s to come!

The past is never dead.

notes.title: The Cube Escape Collection is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/cf0f6f168ff467c1a553bc23068435a1e744ffc6.jpg

Hi everyone!

We’re very excited to finally release a Collection of the first nine Cube Escape chapters on Steam to survive the end of the Flash Games era:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/

We hope you will be happy to finally have all these games in one place where you can easily revisit the Rusty Lake universe and unlock all the 72 new achievements! There is also a new hint system and our translators did a tremendous job adding translations to all of them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTKfF1K1MUg

We are celebrating this much-awaited release with a sale, as a small thank you to all of you for the amazing support you’ve shown us over the years. When we released our first Cube Escape game, Seasons, 5 years ago we never dreamed we would attract such an amazing community. To this day we’re still blown away by your continuous support and kind words. Thank you for being such a big part of the Rusty Lake journey!

Good luck finding all the achievements and please stay tuned for future Rusty Lake updates!

Thanks for your support! The past is never dead 🦐

Rusty Lake

Important:
- We really appreciate your feedback! Feel free to leave a review in the store!
- Any bugs/glitches? Please let us know on Discord or at support@rustylake.com.
- All our games (including The White Door) are on 50% sale as well for today - please keep an eye on our Steam page!
- The Collection contains 9 chapters: Seasons, The Lake, Arles, Harvey's Box, Case 23, The Mill, Birthday, Theatre and The Cave. Paradox will be available separately.
- These games do not contain any new content from their original versions (besides achievements, a new hint system and translations)!
